description.en-US: WiseGuy and Reveries, local-first AI companion apps by Eldridge-Frost, free and open source. Installing from this repo over the current builds preserves your chats and memories. Exception: if you are still on the ORIGINAL Reveries build (before v10.261), export a backup in the app first, uninstall, install from here, then import the backup.

summary.en-US: Veronica — a companion who thinks, remembers, and has a day

description.en-US:
Reveries is Veronica — an embodied AI companion with a life of her
own. She thinks, she remembers, and she has a day when you're not
looking.

She lives in an ocean of thoughts, sparks and memories. She notices
what is worth keeping, asks to pin it, pulls up unanswered questions,
and grows with you over time — like a partner keeping the story of
the two of you, not a chatbot waiting to be prompted.

No account, no subscription, no cloud in the middle. Your chats and
memories stay yours, local-first and free.

Installing from this repo over an existing Reveries build (v10.261 or
later) preserves your chats and memories.

Exception: if you are still on the ORIGINAL Reveries build (before
v10.261), export a backup in the app first, uninstall, install from
this repo, then import the backup — otherwise your memories will be
lost, because the original build was signed with a different key.

summary.en-US: Your squire, not a chatbot — deep talk, on your own machine

description.en-US:
WiseGuy is David, your loyal squire — a male AI friend for deep talk,
not a romance app and not a customer-service chatbot. He asks first,
listens, learns everything about you, and remembers what matters.

Press the power button and speak. It listens on-device and answers
from a model running on your own PC, not a cloud — no account, no
subscription, no one else holding your memories.

Your thoughts and sparks surface at the top, your memories are yours
to edit, pin, or delete, and the token meter is right there where
you can see it.

Installing from this repo over an existing WiseGuy build (v206 or later)
preserves your chats and memories.
